# René Doháň — Senior Software Engineer & Product Lead

> Renetik is the brand of René Doháň, a self-employed software developer registered in Slovakia (EU). Renetik covers his client engineering services, his released software, and his open-source libraries. Renetik Music Apps is his line of ten independent Android music-production apps.

## Services Pages
- [Renetik gateway](https://renetik.com/): Choose René Doháň’s software services or Renetik Music Apps.
- [Introduction](https://renetik.com/services/introduction/): senior engineering, product management, AI-agent workflow, and remote-work profile.
- [Solutions](https://renetik.com/services/solutions/): native mobile, full-stack, SDK, audio, modernization, product, and delivery expertise.
- [Projects](https://renetik.com/services/projects/): 41 selected software projects and case studies.
- [Experience](https://renetik.com/services/experience/): complete 20+ year software and product-delivery timeline.
- [CV](https://renetik.com/services/cv/): focused CV for senior remote engineering, product, and delivery roles.
- [Contact](https://renetik.com/services/contact/): availability, direct contact details, and professional profiles.
- [FAQ](https://renetik.com/faq/): portal-wide FAQ covering Renetik services and Music Apps.
